content.description:
Non-Custodial TekMirio NFT Staking Platform. The design goal was to make it as simple as possible and leverage the new JavaScript Development Tools from Helios, Lucid and Koios to deploy a fully functional modern Web3 decentralized application for the Cardano blockchain.

The MVP is live and can be found here https://app.tekmirio.xyz. Users can stake every NFT in their wallet and the asset never leaves their wallet.
